tokens.npc_dota_hero_luna_bio:
How had she been reduced to this? She was once the Scourge of the Plains, a merciless leader of men and beasts, and able to sow terror wherever she dared. Now she was far from her homeland, driven half mad from starvation and months of wandering, her army long dead or worse. As she stood at the edge of an ancient forest, a pair of glowing eyes spied on from an elder branch. Something beautiful and deadly sought a meal in the wilting dusk. Without a sound, it turned and left. Fury overtook her. Clutching a rust-eaten dagger, she charged after the beast determined to reclaim even a shred of her past glory, but her quarry would not be caught. Three times she cornered the creature among the rocks and trees, and three times she pounced only to witness its fading shadow darting further into the woods. Yet the full moon shone brightly, and the creature's trail was easy to follow.

Arriving in a clearing atop a high hill, the beast's massive feline form sat in the open, attentive and waiting. When the woman brandished her dagger, the creature reared and roared and charged. Death, it seemed, had come for her at long last in this strange place. She stood, calm and ready. A flash of movement, and the beast snatched the dagger from her hand before vanishing into the forest. Stillness. Hooded figures approached. In reverent tones they revealed that Selemene, Goddess of the Moon, had chosen her, had guided her, had tested her. Unwittingly she had endured the sacred rites of the Dark Moon, warriors of the Nightsilver Woods.

She was offered a choice: join the Dark Moon and pledge herself to the service of Selemene, or leave and never return. She did not hesitate. Embracing her absolution, she renounced her bloody past, and took up a new mantle as Luna of the Dark Moon, the dreaded Moon Rider, ruthless and ever-loyal guardian of the Nightsilver Woods.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_luna_hype: Riding swiftly into battle, Luna tears into her enemies with attacks able to bounce between targets. When foes threaten, she calls down the power of the moon as a single searing beam or as a lunar barrage, crushing those who stand against her.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_luna_npedesc1: Tears into her enemies with bouncing attacks

fields.value: None may approach Selemene's chosen without favor from the goddess herself.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Luna's glaive spirals out, rotates around her, and instantly attacks collided enemy units for a portion of her attack damage.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Grants incoming damage reduction while active.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Grants bonus movement speed and increases damage reduction while active.

fields.name: buff1text
fields.value: Glaive Shield: Taking x less damage and damaging nearby enemies.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability has three main components:
** Recasting the ability refreshes the duration, but do not respawn the orbiting glaives.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Clockwise.png|31px|Clockwise]] [[File:Dota2 Luna Lunar Orbit Visualized icon-1.png|84px]] or {{Symbol|bonus t2r}} [[File:Dota2 Luna Lunar Orbit Visualized tal icon-1.png|84px]]
*** Creates {{#var:Lunar Orbit value2}} ({{Symbol|bonus t2r}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Lunar Orbit value2 tal}}|15tal}}) glaives [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]] [[Wikipedia:Logarithmic spiral|logarithmically spiraling]] clockwise upon cast from Luna's current location, point [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] , and reaches its revolution orbit [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] over {{#var:Lunar Orbit basic1}} seconds.
*** Each glaives are placed in the same formation and symmetrically apart each other, with the first glaive always created [[File:Dota2 North.png|31px|North]] {{#var:Lunar Orbit value1}}-distance from Luna, at point [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]] within Circle [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] .
**** {{Code|OP {{=}} {{#var:Lunar Orbit value1}}}}
**** The angle between glaives is defined as:
***** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|θ {{=}} 360° / n}}
*** [[File:Dota2 Luna Lunar Orbit Visualized icon-2.png|84px]]
**** Can affect enemy units at min {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Lunar Orbit value1}}-{{#var:Lunar Orbit value4}}}}-distance and max {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Lunar Orbit value1}}+{{#var:Lunar Orbit value4}}}}-distance away with the orbit radius and glaives collision radius.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Centered on Luna upon cast for the entire duration.
*** Applies generic {{M|incoming damage}} reduction while active.
**** Stacks additively with other incoming damage manipulation sources.
**** Does not reduce {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]] {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Each glaive [[instant attacks]] enemy units within its glaives collision radius for the entire duration upon contact.
**** Has {{#var:Lunar Orbit value3}} ({{Symbol|bonus t3l}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Lunar Orbit value3 tal}}|20tal}})-orbital speed. Hence, each glaive completes a revolution per {{#expr:{{#var:Lunar Orbit value1}}/{{#var:Lunar Orbit value3}} round2}} ({{Symbol|bonus t3l}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Lunar Orbit value1}}/{{#var:Lunar Orbit value3 tal}} round2}}|20tal}}) seconds.
**** Neither procs {{M|attack modifiers}} nor {{M|on-hit effects}}.
**** Have {{M|True Strike}}.
**** Not affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.
**** Do not break invisbility from most sources, including {{A|Shadow Blade|Shadow Walk}}-based items and {{A|Smoke of Deceit|Disguise}}.
*** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
**** Visible to everyone within the {{M|Fog of War}}. 
*** {{Symbol|fx|s}}
**** Audible to everyone when damaging the following units:
***** {{M|Fogged units}}.
***** {{M|Invisible}} units.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: In times of great need, Selemene herself descends into the world, blocking out the light and hope of the opposed.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Temporary obscures the sun, turning the day into night, while showering enemy units with lucent strikes in a radius around Luna.

There is a max number of times that a single target can be struck per cast.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
These lucent strikes are of the corresponding level of Lucent Beam.

The beams do not stun their target.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value:
Increases total beams and the Eclipse duration. Removes the limit on beams per unit, with the beams appearing twice as fast.

Luna may now cast Eclipse on an area, an allied unit, or herself, and have the ability effects follow them.

fields.name: interacts
buff1text
fields.value: Eclipse: Striking nearby targets with Lucent Beam.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
{{Timecard|name=Eclipse}}

* The ability has two main components, with both components independent of each other.
** Recasting the ability creates an independent instance.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|bonus night}}
*** Turns the {{M|Time of Day}} into [[nighttime]] for {{#var:Eclipse value6}} seconds.
*** This ability's component persists Luna's {{M|death}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|luna_eclipse}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Centered on Luna upon cast for the entire duration.
*** Has the following {{A|Luna|Lucent Beam}} properties:
**** Does not apply its {{M|stun}} component.
**** Other Lucent Beam ability notes apply.
*** Does not affect the following units:
**** {{M|Fogged units}}.
**** {{M|Invisible}} units.

* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|No}}
*** Searches for valid enemy units within the radius centerd around Luna.
** {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-1.png|84px]]
*** {{cf|aghnotes}} The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} changes the ability targeting functionality from non-targeted to {{ValueColor||area and unit-targeted|agh}}.
**** The first cast can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Eclipse cast range}}+{{#var:Eclipse type2 value1 agh}}}}|agh}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
**** {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}}
***** When area-targeted, Eclipse happens at the area-targeted location.
***** {{Symbol|Vision|Base}}
****** Grants a {{ValueColor||{{#var:Eclipse value5 agh}}|agh}}-second {{ValueColor||675|agh}}-radius [[vision]] centered around the area-targeted location.
***** Other Eclipse notes apply.
**** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
***** When targeted on an allied unit, Eclipse is centered on the targeted ally for the entire duration.
***** {{M|Doubletap}} casts the ability on Luna.
****** When Luna is {{M|invulnerable}}, she is unable to {{M|Doubletap}} to activate Eclipse.
***** Does not affect the following allied units:
****** {{M|Buildings}}
****** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_luna
data.bio_loc:
How had she been reduced to this? She was once the Scourge of the Plains, a merciless leader of men and beasts, and able to sow terror wherever she dared. Now she was far from her homeland, driven half mad from starvation and months of wandering, her army long dead or worse. As she stood at the edge of an ancient forest, a pair of glowing eyes spied on from an elder branch. Something beautiful and deadly sought a meal in the wilting dusk. Without a sound, it turned and left. Fury overtook her. Clutching a rust-eaten dagger, she charged after the beast determined to reclaim even a shred of her past glory, but her quarry would not be caught. Three times she cornered the creature among the rocks and trees, and three times she pounced only to witness its fading shadow darting further into the woods. Yet the full moon shone brightly, and the creature's trail was easy to follow.

Arriving in a clearing atop a high hill, the beast's massive feline form sat in the open, attentive and waiting. When the woman brandished her dagger, the creature reared and roared and charged. Death, it seemed, had come for her at long last in this strange place. She stood, calm and ready. A flash of movement, and the beast snatched the dagger from her hand before vanishing into the forest. Stillness. Hooded figures approached. In reverent tones they revealed that Selemene, Goddess of the Moon, had chosen her, had guided her, had tested her. Unwittingly she had endured the sacred rites of the Dark Moon, warriors of the Nightsilver Woods.

She was offered a choice: join the Dark Moon and pledge herself to the service of Selemene, or leave and never return. She did not hesitate. Embracing her absolution, she renounced her bloody past, and took up a new mantle as Luna of the Dark Moon, the dreaded Moon Rider, ruthless and ever-loyal guardian of the Nightsilver Woods.
data.hype_loc: Riding swiftly into battle, Luna tears into her enemies with attacks able to bounce between targets. When foes threaten, she calls down the power of the moon as a single searing beam or as a lunar barrage, crushing those who stand against her.
data.npe_desc_loc: Tears into her enemies with bouncing attacks

abilities.name: luna_lucent_beam
abilities.desc_loc: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
abilities.lore_loc: Selemene smites those who encroach upon the Nightsilver Woods.
abilities.shard_loc: Grants Luna an attack damage bonus buff every time an enemy hero is hit by Lucent Beam. Lucent Beams created by Eclipse grant %damage_buff_from_eclipse_pct%%% of the damage amount.

abilities.name: luna_lunar_orbit
abilities.desc_loc: Creates %rotating_glaives% glaives that rotate %rotating_glaives_movement_radius% radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.
abilities.lore_loc: None may approach Selemene's chosen without favor from the goddess herself.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed.
facets_loc: Rotating glaives provide damage reduction while active.

abilities.name: luna_moon_glaive
abilities.desc_loc: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
abilities.lore_loc: Carefully sharpened, Luna's boomerang-like weapon cuts a wide swath through enemy numbers.
notes_loc: Moon Glaives do not proc any attack modifier except Critical Strikes.

abilities.name: luna_lunar_blessing
abilities.desc_loc: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within %radius% range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.
abilities.lore_loc: The Goddess of the Moon smiles upon her kin.

abilities.name: luna_eclipse
abilities.desc_loc: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
abilities.lore_loc: In times of great need, Selemene herself descends into the world, blocking out the light and hope of the opposed.
notes_loc: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
Beams will stop if Luna is killed.
There is a %beam_interval% seconds gap between beams, %beam_interval_scepter% seconds with scepter.
abilities.scepter_loc: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.

talents.name_loc: Lucent Beam Hits An Additional Target
talents.desc_loc: Random target within {s:bonus_lucent_beam_bounce_range} range of the primary target.
